text: Residents and community groups of Ward 11 have long advocated for a bicycle path along the Kitchener Corridor and at the City Council meeting of August 25, 26, and 27, 2010 City Council adopted my motion directing staff to explore all opportunities for a bike trail network north along the Kitchener Corridor, and, if possible, connecting to the West Toronto Railpath and other existing trails. Since 2010, there has been ongoing discussion with Metrolinx regarding the possibility of a rail path along their Kitchener Corridor. Metrolinx has indicated that because of their plans for electrification, all available space is being reserved within their rail corridors to allow for the best/safest electrification design possible. The Ward 11 Pedestrian Safety and Cycling Committee recently met with representatives from Metrolinx to further discuss what options may exist to provide for a multi-use…

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request that Metrolinx, as part of the design of rail corridor electrification, protect for sufficient space or accommodate the design of multi-use trails like the West Toronto Railpath along their rail corridors, as long as safety or other critical design factors are not compromised.
